modmenu.descriptionTranslation.thirdpers: A practical, smooth, feature-rich third-person mod.
thirdpersonplus.text.title: Third Person Plus
thirdpersonplus.text.description: A practical, smooth, feature-rich third-person mod.
thirdpersonplus.button.sync_to_aiming_mo: Synchronize the settings from aiming mode。
thirdpersonplus.button.sync_to_normal_mo: Synchronize the settings from normal mode。
thirdpersonplus.option_category.item_pre: Item predicates to match items. Reference to https://leawind.github.io/Third-Person/en-US/?search=Item+Predicate
thirdpersonplus.option_group.camera_dist: Adjust the camera-to-player distance factor using the mouse wheel when holding specific keys in third-person mode. This setting determines the adjustment range.
thirdpersonplus.option_group.aiming_mode: When aiming with bow, crossbow, trident, etc.
thirdpersonplus.option_group.player_fade: Fade out the player in tight spaces to avoid obstructing the view.
thirdpersonplus.option_group.adjusting_c: By default, holding Z allows you to use the mouse to adjust the camera's offset and distance.
thirdpersonplus.option_group.behavior_in: How the player rotates when pressing the interact key (attack|use|select).
thirdpersonplus.option.is_mod_enabled.de: Disabling this will show the original third-person perspective, but you can still open the configuration screen with a key.
thirdpersonplus.option.center_offset_whe: When the entity the camera is attached to is flying with elytra, do not use camera offset.
thirdpersonplus.option.temp_first_person: Temporarily enter first person while player is in narrow space.
thirdpersonplus.option.player_fade_out_e: When player blocks the sight, make the player semi-transparent.
thirdpersonplus.option.gaze_opacity.desc: When crosshair on entity, set entity opacity to this value.
thirdpersonplus.option.player_invisible_: When camera is close enough, player becomes invisible.
thirdpersonplus.option.use_camera_pick_i: Use camera pick in creative mode
In creative mode, the player's line of sight will not be obstructed, and the crosshair indicates the interaction point.
thirdpersonplus.option.lock_camera_pitch: After locking, it is impossible to rotate up and down.
thirdpersonplus.option.auto_turn_body_dr: Automatically turn sideways when drawing a bow
Automatically turn sideways when drawing a bow, with the hand holding the bow in front and the hand pulling the string behind.
thirdpersonplus.option.available_distanc: Use the mouse wheel to adjust the camera-to-player distance. This option represents the number of distance levels.
thirdpersonplus.option.camera_distance_m: The minimum distance factor from the player when adjusting with the mouse wheel.
The maximum distance from the player when adjusting with the mouse wheel.
thirdpersonplus.option.flying_smooth_hal: Smoothness for camera following player during flight
thirdpersonplus.option.t2f_transition_ha: Smoothness when transition from third-person to first-person.
thirdpersonplus.option.adjusting_camera_: Smoothness for changes in camera offset as the mouse moves while adjusting the camera.
thirdpersonplus.option.adjusting_distanc: Smoothness for changes in camera-to-player distance when adjusting the camera.
thirdpersonplus.option.distance_smooth_h: Time for the camera to move away from the player.
thirdpersonplus.option.aiming_fov_diviso: FOV zoom factor when aiming. The distance between the camera and the player will also change accordingly.
thirdpersonplus.option.is_centered.desc: Whether the player is in the center of the screen.
thirdpersonplus.option.offset_center.des: Long-pressing specific keys can center the view. When centered, the X offset is fixed at 0, and the player is in the middle of the screen. This option adjusts the Y offset at this time.
thirdpersonplus.option.camera_ray_trace_: When the targeted object exceeds this distance while aiming, the player's line of sight will be parallel to the camera's line of sight.
thirdpersonplus.option.camera_distance_m: You will find the difference when adjusting the camera offset.
thirdpersonplus.option.enable_target_ent: Enable target entity prediction when aiming
When aiming, predict the target entity you want to shoot, calculate the player's rotation based on this, for better aiming at the target.
thirdpersonplus.option.skip_vanilla_seco: Only first-person and third-person perspectives are retained
thirdpersonplus.option.disable_third_per: In third person, disable view bobbing
thirdpersonplus.option.allow_double_tap_: In third person mode, allow the vanilla double-tap sprinting feature
thirdpersonplus.option.auto_rotate_inter: When pressing the interact key (attack|use|select), the player will automatically rotate.
thirdpersonplus.option.determine_aim_mod: When specific animation is played, automatically enter aiming mode.
thirdpersonplus.option.hold_to_aim_item_: When the player's left or right hand is holding an item that matches any rule, automatically enter aiming mode.
thirdpersonplus.option.use_to_aim_item_p: When the item the player is using matches any rule, automatically enter aiming mode.
thirdpersonplus.option.use_to_first_pers: Temporarily enter first person when used
When the item the player is using matches any rule, temporarily enter first-person view.
key.thirdpersonplus.toggle_side: Toggle camera to the other side
key.thirdpersonplus.toggle_aiming: Short press to toggle aiming state
key.thirdpersonplus.target_lock: Soft target lock (press: lock / cycle, hold: release)
thirdpersonplus.option_group.target_lock: Softly lock on to an entity in front of the crosshair. Your head and aim follow the target while the camera stays under your control.
Weights used to pick the best candidate inside the cone. The final score is a weighted sum of these criteria.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_enabl: Allows locking on to entities with the target lock key.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_max_d: How far away an entity may be to be locked on to, in blocks.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_cone_: Half-angle of the selection cone around the crosshair, in degrees.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_requi: Only lock on to entities that are actually visible, and release the lock if the target stays hidden.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_inclu: Allow other players to be locked on to.
Allow non-hostile creatures to be locked on to.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_exclu: Never lock on to entities on your team.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_highl: Draw a glowing outline around the locked target.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_lost_: How long the target may stay out of sight before the lock is released.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_weigh: How strongly being close to the centre of the cone is preferred.
How strongly closer entities are preferred.
thirdpersonplus.option.target_lock_bonus: Extra score for the entity that is already locked, to keep the selection stable.
Extra score for entities that are currently targeting you.
